description: Compare 2-5 strategies side by side on their key performance metrics: ROI, max drawdown, win rate, Sharpe ratio, rating, and active bot count. Use this to help a user choose between strategies from the marketplace or their own library before backtesting or deploying one. Read-only. Get strategy IDs from list_strategies.

ids.description: Array of 2-5 strategy IDs to compare, obtained from list_strategies or get_strategy.

name: compare_strategies
